# R6 deterministic history inventory

The executable owner is `R6PrefixHistoryTests`; `Economics/Histories` supplies the bounded callable replay/growth results. Inputs reuse the existing copied R5 authored fixtures. This inventory is documentation, not a second runtime-loaded manifest or answer channel.

| Case                                 | Input / execution owner                                                   | Required outcome                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Bootstrap, same head, verified ahead | `r5/replay`; `HistoryRunner.ReplayAsync`                                  | Three actual child PIDs; accepted generations 0–2; independent encrypted predecessor restore and exact P1 historical segment agreement.                               |
| Prior-only fact                      | `ReplayCoverage` and `ReplayTransport`                                    | The script uses a history slot reference. New context/policy/diff/current tool results exclude the answer; the ahead snapshot removes its source file entirely.       |
| Tool-heavy                           | `r5/growth`; `HistoryRunner.GrowthAsync(..., "tools")`                    | Five accepted runs, then actual next response crosses the message limit. Predecessor remains restorable and unchanged.                                                |
| Continuation-heavy                   | `r5/growth`; `HistoryRunner.GrowthAsync(..., "continuation")`             | Six accepted runs, then actual next continuation crosses its byte limit. Predecessor remains unchanged.                                                               |
| Missing history                      | Existing Replay fault                                                     | `history_failed`; prefix evidence is unmeasurable, never positive.                                                                                                    |
| Reordered history                    | Post-restore reconstructed request mutation                               | `unknown_failed`; production admission rejects before a valid continuation can be accepted.                                                                           |
| Changed continuation                 | Existing Replay fault                                                     | Historical logical/provider segments change; SESSION construction fails. Projection change and runtime rejection are separate observations.                           |
| Missing / misplaced continuation     | Existing Replay faults                                                    | `unknown_failed`; no accepted successor.                                                                                                                              |
| Wrong scope/head, stale generation   | Actual encrypted-state restore request                                    | `state_failed`; no provider request; predecessor preserved.                                                                                                           |
| Policy/model/adapter mismatch        | Requested state admission identity                                        | `state_failed`; no provider request; no new product configuration.                                                                                                    |
| Tool commitment mismatch             | SESSION/root admission mutation                                           | Existing admission rejects the changed commitment; no configurable tool registry.                                                                                     |
| Explicit reset after capacity        | Existing production Host `VerifyCapacityResetAsync` and `ResetProbeWorld` | Rejected growth preserves predecessor; explicit reset changes epoch/session, accepts generation 0, excludes old content and continues independently in the new epoch. |

The reset probe topology is in-process production Host with synthetic ports. It is separate from the fresh-process Replay matrix. Its existing bounded `ResetCapacityReport` is reused; it is not a new public R6 protocol. V1 owns dispatcher and framework/AOT integration.

All traffic is synthetic. No provider cache hit, provider cost, savings or model-quality conclusion follows from these deterministic results.
